name: Snapshot and Compaction
description: Periodically compact the operation log into snapshots. Old operations are archived, not deleted.
purpose: Prevent unbounded operation log growth by periodically compacting into snapshots while preserving history through archival rather than deletion.
acceptanceCriteria: Compaction produces a snapshot: the convergent state after applying all operations up to a point.
Archived operations are stored separately, not deleted.
Snapshots are content-addressed and can be transferred for fast catch-up.
Compaction is configurable (interval, max log size).
Compaction preserves causal metadata for archived operations.
Rejoin from snapshot+archived-delta is correct and tested.
